Exclusive to participants of the dagram x HFM trading contest (see pinned post). Step 1: like this post and follow dagram. Step 2: [join the 2-million-yen-prize contest and declare participation on Discord] *You'll also be able to see the Discord early-call room and trade streams. Step 3: [write your TradingView account name in the 'blaze and fusion indicator (TradingView invitation request)' form]. BLAZE Ver4.0 by dagram MASTER CLASS: after installing, when 'LONG' or 'STRONG BUY' appears near the upper limit of the band channel shown on the chart, and 'SELL' or 'STRONG SELL' near the lower limit, just enter as indicated. Recommended: gold, 3-minute and 5-minute charts. *It generally works on any symbol and any timeframe. dagram Fusion Oscillator *recommended together with BLAZE. *After applying -> once usage rights are granted, restart TradingView -> Indicators -> Invite-only and select it. It's an oscillator that integrates CCI, Williams %R, ADX and ATR into one to judge momentum, trend strength and volatility comprehensively. Role of each indicator: CCI: price momentum, overbought/oversold; Williams %R: timing of short-term reversals; ADX: trend strength; ATR: size of price movement. How to read signals: BUY: crossing above the 0 line + color turns green + BUY shown -> buyers dominant. SELL: crossing below the 0 line + color turns red + SELL shown -> sellers dominant. Strong trend: +40 or above: strong rise (buying dips favored); -40 or below: strong fall (selling rallies favored). *Oscillation around 0 (+/-10) or repeated BUY/SELL is likely a range, so skipping is recommended. How to use on the gold 3-minute chart: Long: Fusion crosses above the 0 line, new high, above the 20 EMA, Fusion at +20 or above. Short: Fusion crosses below the 0 line, new low, below the 20 EMA, Fusion at -20 or below. Points for raising the win rate: rather than a signal alone, combining the following reduces false signals: ADX > 25, ATR above a certain level, same direction as EMA50 and EMA200, high/low breakout, increased volume. Warning: this does not guarantee profit. It is an indicator developed to be used as a discretionary aid. #FX #Gold #Trade
